name: Wave Shader
tagline: A landing-page hero over a live, wavy gradient: silk, an aurora, a sunset sea or a silky ribbon, drifting slowly under your cursor.
youSay: /wave-shader a launch page for Sorbet, a colour palette tool, warm and soft
whatYouGet: A landing page whose hero is a live, wavy surface of colour: warm silk, an aurora curtain, a sea at sunset or a vivid silky ribbon
Motion that stays calm: slow drift, a surface that leans toward the cursor and ripples where you click
The page around it: brand, copy, type and a layout made for the look, on wide screens, tall windows and phones
A static site with no libraries: one small WebGL2 engine, a CSS fallback and a still frame for reduced motion
goodFit: Launch and product pages that want a premium, calm first screen
Brands with a colour story: palettes, travel, wellness, fintech, night skies
notFor: Pages that need a photo or product image as the hero
youBring: What the page is for and the brand name
Optional: colours, mood, headline and fonts
